cards.back: Both compositions must be at least 1 minute each — the score must be in staff notation (up to 4 sharps/flats) with a recording.

cards.back: AO2 marks: technical control (accuracy of notation, appropriate writing for instruments), coherence (logical structure, development), creative development (inventive use of elements).

cards.front: What should you know about music exam tips?
cards.back: Address EVERY element of the brief. Plan structure and development. Reference AoS influences. Meet notation requirements. Understand AO2 criteria.

Students often make mistakes here. Wrong: The composition brief is just a suggestion — you can write whatever you want. Correct: You MUST respond directly to the brief's requirements — examiners check that your composition addresses each element of the stimulus.
